intro.title: Visibility alone is not enough
intro.body_1: In real estate, the difference also comes down to how you're perceived, how fast you respond, and how well you represent your area.
intro.body_2: IkiHomes exists to help the right agents be better positioned when a buyer is actually ready to move forward.

items.title: Get set before opening
items.description: Agents who join at this stage will be able to organize their presence before IkiHomes opens publicly in their zone.

items.title: A profile that builds trust
items.description: Credibility isn't built on listings alone. It's also built on presentation, clarity, and responsiveness.

items.title: Stronger position at launch
items.description: When the first inquiries start coming in, agents who are already prepared to respond with professionalism will have the edge.

steps.title: The buyer shares what they're looking for
steps.description: Zone, budget, property type, and buying context.

steps.title: The platform identifies relevant agents
steps.description: IkiHomes prioritizes proximity to the zone, professional presentation, and readiness to handle real opportunities.

steps.title: Agents who respond well stand out
steps.description: Each inquiry becomes a real opportunity for agents who project trust and respond with speed.

differentiation.title: Built for a market where trust matters
differentiation.body: IkiHomes isn't trying to fill a page with profiles. It's designed to create an environment where buyers can more easily identify agents who project professionalism, local knowledge, and responsiveness.

cards.title: Visible trust
cards.description: Credibility should come through from the very first contact.

cards.title: Response that sets you apart
cards.description: Responding on time isn't a detail. It's part of how a buyer evaluates an agent.

cards.title: Relevance by zone
cards.description: Being well positioned in the right area is worth more than showing up everywhere without context.

built_for_cr.title: Built for how real estate moves in Costa Rica
built_for_cr.body: Here, real estate runs on trust, follow-through, and real knowledge of each zone. IkiHomes is being built with that logic: better positioning, less noise, and a more useful experience for both buyers and agents.

early_edge.title: Showing up ready makes the difference
early_edge.body: Early access isn't just about timing. It's about arriving with your profile, presence, and positioning already in place for when IkiHomes begins opening market by zone.

final_cta.title: Request early access and launch in a stronger position
final_cta.body: IkiHomes will roll out in stages across Costa Rica. Now is the time to be ready.

blog_teaser.title: From the blog
blog_teaser.card_title: Costa Rica Has MLS — But Not the Way You Think
blog_teaser.card_description: Costa Rica has MLS systems, but none are mandatory or cover the whole market. How this fragmentation impacts your business and what you can do.

about.title: About IkiHomes
about.content: IkiHomes is a platform that connects property buyers in Costa Rica with professional agents — ranked by responsiveness and trust, not just by who pays more.

footer.trust_line: Made in Costa Rica · Real Buyers · Real Agents
